name: 2′-Bromonordazepam
summary: 2′-Bromonordazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative which is the 2'-bromo derivative of nordazepam. It was invented in the 1970s but was never marketed. It is a potent benzodiazepine comparable in strength to clonazepam with similar sedative and anxiolytic effects, but is not known to have been marketed as a designer drug.
